_comment: PRD-CORE-329 contract (charter Q3): every reader of .trw/runtime/decisions.jsonl (trw-mcp's trw_status/session_start/resolve, trw-loop's preflight gate) must derive exactly this from decision_queue_v1.jsonl. A resolution with actor 'unattended' never resolves (FR08 rule 3), so decision ...1111 stays pending; ...2222 is resolved by an attended actor; ...3333 has no resolution. oldest_pending is by queue order (the first pending record's position), never by ts, since ts is caller-written.
